cards.text: Final Acceptance Recommendation for Dedication of Private Roads into the County Maintenance System

Information concerning the above set out roads has been reviewed. All plats meet the GIS standards of the department and all required information has been provided in appropriate and acceptable forms. No additional required information is outstanding.
I give m y unqualified approval for acceptance of these roads as public roads to be maintained b y Lumpkin County.
I give m y qualified approval for acceptance of these roads as publicroads. The reasons for my qualified acceptance and all comments and limitations are set out in an addendum to this memorandum.
For reasons set out in detail in the attached addendum, I recommend that the above set out roads NOT be accepted as County Roads.
Final Acceptance Recommendation for Dedication of Private Roads into the County Maintenance System

The above set out roads have been examined prior to grading, during base preparation, during paving, and after paving was completed. All work is in accordance with state and local statutes, regulations, guidelines and standards. No work remains and the roads meet all environmental requirements and standards.

Fire Department: The above set out roads have been examined and determined to be adequate to permit fire department and other emergency apparatus to access properties fronting on the roads. This certification is limited to access to all parts of the roads being dedicated and does not certify any movement off the road network proposed to be adopted as county roads.
